sentences.text: Mental health social worker Aisha Bello (S1) identified as being from the community mental health team and attending on referral from GP Dr Shah (L1).
Callum Reid (S2) stated his mother was at work and present during the assessment (L4).
Callum Reid (S2) reported feeling low since the summer and dropping out of college in September (L8).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he was studying Engineering at Level three before stopping (L10).
Callum Reid (S2) reported sleeping badly, staying up until 4 or 5 am gaming and sleeping during the day (L12).
Callum Reid (S2) reported eating very little, mostly toast, with his mother leaving food (L14).
Callum Reid (S2) reported having asthma and using an inhaler, with no other physical health problems (L16).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he was not currently working or receiving money, having previously worked a Christmas temp at a warehouse last year (L18).
Callum Reid (S2) stated his mother knows he is down but not the rest of how he is feeling (L22).
Callum Reid (S2) disclosed that he cuts his arms, stating this happens most nights for about two months (L26, L28).
Callum Reid (S2) stated the cuts are not deep, are healing all right, and he keeps his sleeves down (L30).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he has wanted to die properly in the last few weeks (L34).
Callum Reid (S2) disclosed that last week he went to Calder Bridge, stood there thinking about jumping, but walked home (L38, L40, L42).
Callum Reid (S2) stated his mother and his dog, Bailey (a Staffy, three years old), stopped him from jumping off the bridge (L44).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he has never taken an overdose of tablets or anything (L48).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he has no stored-up tablets in the flat, only his mother's paracetamol in the kitchen (L52).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he is not going to do anything today (L50).
Callum Reid (S2) reported his mother works as a nurse mostly at night and they do not really talk about things (L20).
Callum Reid (S2) reported not really talking to friends, except for an online mate named Josh and a sister at university in Leeds (L24).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he would be okay with the crisis team seeing him tomorrow (L56).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he does not know how to tell his mother about his feelings (L58).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) agreed to ring the crisis team as soon as she leaves to arrange a visit today for Callum Reid (S2) (L63).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) agreed to ring Callum Reid's (S2) mother with him at 6 pm tonight (L63).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) agreed to book a practice nurse to look at Callum Reid's (S2) arms on Thursday the twenty-sixth (L63).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) agreed to return to see Callum Reid (S2) on Monday the thirtieth (L63).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) suggested looking into Universal Credit and getting back to college when Callum Reid (S2) is ready (L65).
Callum Reid (S2) stated he might be interested in looking into Universal Credit and getting back to college (L66).
Social worker Aisha Bello (S1) advised that if things get bad before the agreed actions, Callum Reid (S2) should ring the crisis line, call 999, or go to A&E (L67).
